title: Skulk Rock

[[Image:Skulk Rock.jpg|thumb|Skulk Rock]]
'''Skulk Rock''' is a forest troll ruin, infested with [[Slime]]s. A cave exists in this area, and it is one of the few places one can find [[Ghost Mushroom]]s.
